policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-five goals exceed what the six lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the conference's scoring is one bar and then a slope.

claims.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-five goals exceed what the six lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the conference's scoring is one bar and then a slope.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Four matches past their date carry no published result: Drury's at home to Evangel and away at Wash U, Missouri S&T's visit to Kentucky Wesleyan, and Lincoln's home match with McKendree, the one conference match of 9 September without a result.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference yet to lose: two wins and two draws, six goals scored and three conceded, with Sunday's win over Southwest Baptist their first at home.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Southwest Baptist have won three, drawn one and lost one, scoring twenty-five and conceding five; the defeat came at Lincoln on Sunday, and eight different players have scored for them.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: Drury have won five and lost one, scoring fourteen and conceding four; the defeat was at home to Oklahoma Christian, and they have not dropped a point since.

claims.label: derived
claims.text: William Jewell have lost all five of their matches; Daniel Pirillo's goal at Indianapolis on Saturday was their first of the season, against nine conceded.
